sentences.text: 1. This motion is moved for speaking to the minutes.

2. It is contention of the learned Counsel for appellants that This Order is Speaking to Minutes order of order dated //
2 FA 1536-2014 inadvertently in order dated 26/06/2024 the interest payable under Section 28 and 34 of the Act is not included in the operative part of the order.

Said error is inadvertently occurred,
it is to be corrected.
3. It is held that the claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation and would be entitled to claim interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act @ 9% per annum from the date of award.
Similarly claimants would be entitled to get interest @ 9% per annum for first year under Section 34 of the Act and thereafter 15% per annum from the date of award till realization of the amount.
